name: What is the difference between elastomeric and acrylic paint for exteriors?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between elastomeric and acrylic paint for exteriors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elastomeric paint is a specialized coating known for its high elasticity and flexibility, making it excellent for bridging and preventing cracks, especially on stucco or masonry surfaces. It provides superior waterproofing and can last longer than traditional paints. Acrylic latex paints, while also flexible and durable, offer a good balance of protection, breathability, and color retention for a wider range of exterior surfaces. While elastomeric offers enhanced crack resistance, acrylic is generally more cost-effective and versatile for standard applications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Elastomeric paint is highly elastic, ideal for bridging cracks and waterproofing stucco. Acrylic paint is versatile, durable, and good for various surfaces with good color retention.
